video_title: Cavs Practice | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.19.2026

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the team's moralistic approach to basketball
quotes.excerpt: I think we all want to do the right thing, to play for one another.
quotes.quote: I think we've all been playing basketball for such a long time that we've kind of heard it all. There is a fear concerning that stuff. I think with him, it's more so playing basketball from a moralistic standpoint, playing basketball with morality. I think we all want to do the right thing, to play for one another. We're all going to have to sacrifice at points in time. He knows that, so he's just trying to get us used to that early.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says the Cavs are focusing on playing with morality and sacrifice this season. He notes that the team is emphasizing doing the right thing and playing for one another.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the team's focus on basketball fundamentals
quotes.excerpt: It's more so play with defensive, be alert, communicate out there, rebound, control what you can control.
quotes.quote: A lot of what he talks to me about is not get more arc on your jump shot or be in this place to do that. It's more so play with defensive, be alert, communicate out there, rebound, control what you can control. It's just those little things that he reminds us about because in the game, the schematics and everything matters and the analytics matter. You want to be a smart player with a good IQ, but at the end of the day, a lot of it comes down to will power and who wants it the most. We've got to be that team.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says his focus is on the little things like defense and communication rather than just analytics. He believes that at the end of the day, success comes down to willpower and who wants it the most.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on adjusting to playing alongside James and Nance
quotes.excerpt: It's a lot different playing from the outside in as opposed to the inside out.
quotes.quote: It's a lot different playing from the outside in as opposed to the inside out. Obviously, the first four years of my career, I played with super talented offensive bigs, probably the most talented of all time, and it made things easy for me. But I also had adjustments to make there where it was being in the right place at the right time, being in the right spot, spacing the floor correctly so that he could have the space to operate in the interior. I think now it's a little bit different because it's more so moving with the ball on the perimeter. So, making sure that my spacing is correct depending on which way the ball is driven, and then also finding avenues to cut.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson on adjusting to his new role: It is a lot different playing from the outside in. He is working on his spacing and finding cutting lanes while playing alongside James and Nance.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his defensive role alongside Nance and Jarrett
quotes.excerpt: Having those two guys in their interior presence just helps us a lot.
quotes.quote: Having that back line there that helps me out and kind of deter shots at the rim or make that ball handler think twice before going in there. And even that little hesitation is enough for me to recover and keep the defense all balanced and keep them guessing. So, I think that having those two guys in their interior presence just helps us a lot. And then also just us, even though those guys are bigger than me, us having similar size, I think our switchability becomes better.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says the interior presence of Nance and Jarrett helps the Cavs defense. He believes their combined size makes the team much more switchable on the perimeter.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his vocal leadership and defensive communication
quotes.excerpt: I take it upon myself regardless if somebody told me I was responsible or not.
quotes.quote: I take it upon myself regardless if somebody told me I was responsible or not. That's just something that I like to do out there, just to make sure that everybody's on the same page. So, I think that I fit in well here. This is a really player-led and player-driven team, and that's something that I'm not as used to, but it's very, very fun to be a part of because you kind of get to talk the game out with the guys who are out there, and that matters a lot.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says he is enjoying the player-led culture in Cleveland. He noted that it is a very fun environment where the players get to talk the game out together.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on handling the pressure of high expectations
quotes.excerpt: It's one thing to have goals. It's another thing to put the steps in place.
quotes.quote: I think it's just not just talking about it. We got to be about it. It's one thing to have goals. It's another thing to put the steps in place and the things in order for you to be able to do those things. This is going to be one of those things where this is not a full-on sprint. This is a marathon of a season, and we've got to be about the right things. We've got to take care of our bodies. We've got to make smart decisions off the floor. We've got to do what's best for one another on the court and be willing to sacrifice at any given time.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson on the upcoming season: This is not a full on sprint. It is a marathon and we have to be about the right things and take care of our bodies.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the team's mindset heading into the season
quotes.excerpt: Go out there with a mean streak. I think go out there and try to kill.
quotes.quote: Go out there with a mean streak. I think go out there and try to kill. Take no prisoners mentality. I think that's my mentality and that's something that I will be echoing in the team, but there is no time for being nice, buddy-buddy with the opposition. I think the league is more competitive than ever, and there are guys going out there that are trying to take what you have, and they want what you have. And I think being a good team is a blessing, but also a curse when it comes to the target on our back as well.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson wants the Cavs to play with a mean streak this season. He says there is no time for being nice or buddy-buddy with the opposition because the league is more competitive than ever.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the challenge of maintaining a competitive edge
quotes.excerpt: There are no excuses in this game. We've got to be ready to play every single night.
quotes.quote: It's tricky because you always want to keep a competitive edge, but there are no excuses in this game. We've got to be ready to play every single night, and that's that.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says there are no excuses in the NBA. He believes the team has to be ready to play every single night to maintain their competitive edge.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the commonalities of championship teams
quotes.excerpt: The overall camaraderie that we have, not only just between us players because we all have great relationships.
quotes.quote: The overall camaraderie that we have, not only just between us players because we all have great relationships, everybody's cool, gets along well, we hang out off the court, but just with the staff as well, the front office. I think that everybody's on the same page, and everybody's got the same mindset. And that's something that we've been preaching since we took the trip together to Marbella, and we spent a lot of time together. And I think that that closeness will help us as the season goes on because we're going to be with each other every day.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson credits the team's trip to Marbella for building camaraderie. He believes the closeness between the players, staff, and front office will help the team as the season progresses.
